title: Development and Launch of mRNA-based Vaccines for Cancer in Singapore
what_it_is: Development and Launch of mRNA-based Vaccines for Cancer in Singapore

sections.label: mRNA cancer vaccine research funding
sections.summary: MOH supports mRNA-based cancer vaccine research through funding, collaborations, local disease focus and the Singapore Translational Cancer Consortium.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Through Research, Innovation and Enterprise funding over the years, competitive cancer research projects in Singapore have been supported by the Ministry of Health (MOH)'s National Medical Research Council, including the development of mRNA-based cancer vaccines.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, the National University Cancer Institute, Singapore, is developing an Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) vaccine platform using lipid nanoparticle mRNA vaccine technology.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Agency for Science and Technolody Research is leading the research that combines genomic knowledge about EBV and nasopharyngeal cancer (NPC), to develop better mRNA vaccines against EBV that can reduce the risk of developing NPC, which tends to affect Asians more.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Scientists at the National University of Singapore are investigating the combined use of a personalised RNA-based cancer vaccine with RNA based immune-checkpoint inhibitor treatments for patients with Acute Myeloid Leukemia.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Research on the efficacy of mRNA-based vaccines against cancers is still at an early stage and none has been approved yet to treat or prevent cancer.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: However, given the potential of this approach, MOH will continue to support the development of suitable mRNA-based vaccines to treat cancer, as well as other important medical conditions in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This includes: one, providing funding support for such research; two, supporting research collaborations between our researchers and overseas partners; three, supporting local research focusing on diseases that affect our local ethnic populations disproportionately; and four, working through the Singapore Translational Cancer Consortium to better coordinate, integrate and support the work of key local cancer research stakeholders.

sections.label: Singapore clinical trial platforms
sections.summary: Clinical trials are independent of mRNA vaccines, and Singapore has platforms, processes and investments to host more trials.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The process of conducting clinical trials is independent of the fact of mRNA vaccines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We have a number of platforms, processes and significant investments in developing the ability to do better and more clinical trials here in Singapore to act as a hub for both the patient selection, as well as the information management and subsequent analysis of these trials.
